01Is the slab in the number?

02Is delivery included?

Yes. Delivery and install by our own crew.

03Who installs it?

The same crew that built your slab. One crew, one invoice.

04How long is the price good?

6 months, locked in writing.

05When do I pay?

10–17% to order; the balance once installed.

Yes — engineered to your ZIP code’s wind and load requirements.

Straight answers

Questions we get every day.

Can’t find yours? Call (205) 941-6115 — you’ll reach a person.

What does steel gauge mean?

Gauge is steel thickness, and a lower number is thicker steel. Our standard frame is 14-gauge (12-gauge is the upgrade) and standard panels are 29-gauge (26-gauge for commercial buildings).

What is a clear-span building?

A clear-span building has no support posts inside. The roof trusses carry the load across the full width, so the whole floor is usable for parking, work and storage.

What is a turn-down footing?

The slab is poured thicker along its edge — 8″ × 8″ — as one piece with the slab, so the walls sit on a solid, monolithic edge instead of a thin slab.

Regular, A-frame or vertical roof — which is better?

Regular and A-frame are the standard styles. A vertical roof runs the panels from peak to eave so water, leaves and debris shed faster. It is the premium option.

Do I have to be there for the install?

No. Most owners choose turnkey: we handle delivery and install, and you get a walk-around at the end.

What if I am just looking?

Good. Ask for the number and keep it. No harm if it just sits in a drawer.
